title: 有馬記念の後に・誰もの心に一輪の

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Applause rains down on Rice Shower, the victor of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Rice Shower gave the performance of her life in the ultimate race—a feat that's brought a smile to everyone's face.
